fn compress(s: Str) -> Str
= do

  var cur = ""
  var cnt = 0
  for c in s.chars

      cur := c
      cnt := 1
  if cnt > 0 then out := out + run_str(cur, cnt)
  out

= do
  parts = cmd.split(" ")
  first_word = parts.first.or("")
  match first_word
  | "push" =>

    else catch parts.get(1).or("").to_int

    if stack.is_empty then raise MissingArg{cmd: "pop"}
    else stack.take(stack.len - 1)
  | "add" =>
    if stack.len < 2 then raise MissingArg{cmd: "add"}
    else do
      a = stack.get(stack.len - 1).or(0)

  for cmd in cmds do
    parts = cmd.split(" ")

    match first_word
    | "push" =>
      if parts.len < 2 then messages := messages.push("missing: push")
      else

          | _ => none

        | none => messages := messages.push("missing: push")
        | some(n) => stack := stack.push(n)
    | "pop" =>
      if stack.is_empty then messages := messages.push("missing: pop")
      else stack := stack.take(stack.len - 1)
    | "add" =>
      if stack.len < 2 then messages := messages.push("missing: add")
      else do
        a = stack.get(stack.len - 1).or(0)
        b = stack.get(stack.len - 2).or(0)
        stack := stack.take(stack.len - 2).push(a + b)
    | _ => messages := messages.push("unknown: " + first_word)
  stack.map(_.str).join(",")

fn zip_with[A, B, C](xs: List[A], ys: List[B], f: (A, B) -> C) -> List[C]
= do
  var result = []
  var i = 0
  var x_len = xs.len
  var y_len = ys.len
  var min_len = min(x_len, y_len)
  for _ in 0..min_len
    result := result.push(f(xs[i], ys[i]))
    i := i + 1
  result

fn kth_smallest(t: Tree, k: Int) -> Opt[Int]
= do
  fn inorder_count(node: Tree, target: Int) -> Opt[Int]
    = match node
      | Leaf => none
      | Node{left, value, right} =>
        do
          var left_count = count_nodes(left)
          if target == left_count + 1 then some(value)
          else if target <= left_count then inorder_count(left, target)
          else inorder_count(right, target - left_count - 1)

  fn count_nodes(node: Tree) -> Int
    = match node
      | Leaf => 0
      | Node{left, value, right} => 1 + count_nodes(left) + count_nodes(right)

  inorder_count(t, k)

fn tree_height_balanced(t: Tree) -> Bool
= do
  fn height(node: Tree) -> Int
    = match node
      | Leaf => 0
      | Node{left, value, right} => 1 + max(height(left), height(right))

  fn is_balanced(node: Tree) -> Bool
    = match node
      | Leaf => true
      | Node{left, value, right} =>
        do
          var l_height = height(left)
          var r_height = height(right)
          (l_height - r_height).abs <= 1 and is_balanced(left) and is_balanced(right)

  is_balanced(t)

fn spiral(m: List[List[Int]]) -> List[Int]
= do
  if m.is_empty then []
  else do
    var result = []
    var top = 0
    var bottom = m.len - 1
    var left = 0
    var right = if m.len > 0 then m.first.or([]).len - 1 else 0

    while top <= bottom and left <= right do
      for col in left..right + 1
        if top <= bottom then
          result := result.push(m[top][col])
      top := top + 1

      for row in top..bottom + 1
        if left <= right then
          result := result.push(m[row][right])
      right := right - 1

      if top <= bottom then
        for col in (left..right + 1).reverse
          result := result.push(m[bottom][col])
        bottom := bottom - 1

      if left <= right then
        for row in (top..bottom + 1).reverse
          result := result.push(m[row][left])
        left := left + 1

    result

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  pre xs.len > 0
= do
  var best = xs[0]
  var cur = xs[0]
  for i in 1..xs.len
    cur := max(xs[i], cur + xs[i])
    best := max(best, cur)
  best

fn transpose(m: List[List[Int]]) -> List[List[Int]]

fn dedupe_adjacent(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
= do
  var out = xs.take(0)
  for i in 0..xs.len
    if i == 0 or xs[i] != xs[i - 1] then out := out.push(xs[i])
  out

fn opener_of(c: Str) -> Str
= if c == ")" then "(" else if c == "]" then "[" else if c == "}" then "{" else ""

fn is_opener(c: Str) -> Bool
= c == "(" or c == "[" or c == "{"

fn bal_step(st: List[Str], c: Str) -> Opt[List[Str]]
= if is_opener(c) then some(st.push(c)) else if opener_of(c) != "" then bal_pop(st, opener_of(c)) else some(st)

fn bal_pop(st: List[Str], o: Str) -> Opt[List[Str]]
= if st.is_empty then none else if st[st.len - 1] == o then some(st.take(st.len - 1)) else none

fn bal_go(cs: List[Str], i: Int, st: List[Str]) -> Bool
= if i == cs.len then st.is_empty else bal_next(cs, i, bal_step(st, cs[i]))

fn bal_next(cs: List[Str], i: Int, r: Opt[List[Str]]) -> Bool
= match r
  | some(n) => bal_go(cs, i + 1, n)
  | none => false

fn is_balanced(s: Str) -> Bool

fn shift_char(c: Str, k: Int) -> Str
= match alphabet().chars.enumerate().find(p => p.1 == c)
  | some(p) => alphabet().get(((p.0 + k) % 26 + 26) % 26).or(c)
  | none => c

fn shift_letters(s: Str, k: Int) -> Str

fn insert(t: Tree, x: Int) -> Tree
= match t
  | Leaf => Node{left: Leaf, value: x, right: Leaf}
  | Node{left, value, right} => if x < value then Node{left: insert(left, x), value: value, right: right} else if x > value then Node{left: left, value: value, right: insert(right, x)} else t

  | Leaf => []
  | Node{left, value, right} => inorder(left) + [value] + inorder(right)

fn bal_combine(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
= if a < 0 or b < 0 or (a - b).abs > 1 then -1 else max(a, b) + 1

fn bal_h(t: Tree) -> Int
= match t
  | Leaf => 0
  | Node{left, right} => bal_combine(bal_h(left), bal_h(right))

fn tree_height_balanced(t: Tree) -> Bool

fn step(v: Vending, a: Action) -> (Vending, Str)
= match a
  | Coin{cents} => (HasCoins{cents: held(v) + cents}, "")
  | Buy{price} => if held(v) >= price then (Idle, "vend change {held(v) - price}") else (v, "need {price - held(v)}")
  | Refund => (Idle, "refund {held(v)}")

fn held(v: Vending) -> Int
= match v
  | Idle => 0
  | HasCoins{cents} => cents

fn sim_step(v: Vending, a: Action) -> (Vending, List[Str])
= match a
  | Coin{cents} => (HasCoins{cents: held(v) + cents}, [])
  | Buy{price} => if held(v) >= price then (Idle, ["vend change {held(v) - price}"]) else (v, ["need {price - held(v)}"])
  | Refund => (Idle, ["refund {held(v)}"])

fn sim_next(r: (Vending, List[Str]), rest: List[Action], acc: List[Str]) -> List[Str]
= sim_go(r.0, rest, acc + r.1)

fn sim_go(v: Vending, rest: List[Action], acc: List[Str]) -> List[Str]
= match rest.first
  | none => acc
  | some(a) => sim_next(sim_step(v, a), rest.drop(1), acc)

fn tr_(m: List[List[Int]]) -> List[List[Int]]
= match m.first
  | none => []
  | some(r) => if r.is_empty then [] else [m.map(row => row[0])] + tr_(m.map(row => row.drop(1)))

fn spiral(m: List[List[Int]]) -> List[Int]
= match m.first
  | none => []
  | some(row) => row + spiral(tr_(m.drop(1)).reverse)
